title: Coherent discrete head shapes show the octanol effect is instructive rather than toxic

fields.label: Label
fields.value: Coherent discrete head shapes show the octanol effect is instructive rather than toxic

fields.label: Statement
fields.value: The octanol-induced head-shape change in G. dorotocephala is instructive rather than a toxic or housekeeping defect, because it yields one of several coherent, ecologically valid morphologies rather than regeneration failure or disorganized growth, with no intermediate morphologies observed.

fields.label: Work
fields.value: Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms

fields.label: Chapter
fields.value: Emmons-Bell M 2015, Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms › 3. Discussion › 3.1. Perturbation of Bioelectric Networks Produces Inter-Species Morphological Change

fields.label: Quotation
fields.value: The head morphology alteration effect was instructive, and not merely one of toxicity or a house-keeping defect, because the outcome was not merely disruption of regenerative ability or a generalized mis-patterning (e.g., tumor or other disorganized growth), but rather resulted in one of several coherent (and ecologically-valid) morphologies.

fields.label: Assumptions
fields.value: Emmons-Bell M, Durant F, Hammelman J, Bessonov N, Volpert V, Morokuma J, Pinet K, Adams DS, Pietak A, Lobo D, Levin M, “Gap Junctional Blockade Stochastically Induces Different Species-Specific Head Anatomies in Genetically Wild-Type Girardia dorotocephala Flatworms”, International journal of molecular sciences (2015), doi:10.3390/ijms161126065; section “3. Discussion › 3.1. Perturbation of Bioelectric Networks Produces Inter-Species Morphological Change”. Scope: Octanol-treated G. dorotocephala regenerates

fields.label: Assessment
fields.value: GPT-5.6 Sol on levin-2015-girardia-10: partially-resolvable, resolvability 0.57

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Existing measurements can distinguish gross toxicity from organized regeneration. They cannot fully discriminate an instructive gap-junction mechanism from selective toxicity or other off-target perturbations.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Quantify survival, regeneration completion, disorder metrics, and clustering of blinded head shapes after octanol versus toxicity controls. Discrete coherent outcomes with normal viability would weigh against generalized toxicity but would not exclude selective off-target effects.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Coherence does not uniquely imply instructive signaling.

Octanol has possible targets beyond gap junctions.

No intermediate morphologies is sensitive to sample size and classification.

fields.label: Dimension scores
fields.value:
analysis feasibility: 0.75
discriminating power: 0.45
data adequacy: 0.45
operationalizability: 0.7
data existence: 0.55

fields.label: Finding
fields.value: Coherent species-like heads versus failed or disorganized regeneration is an observable classification. The paper reports that only the coherent classes occurred. The animal-level classifications are not public, so the negative observation cannot be re-tallied, and a new scored cohort would be required to test it.

fields.label: Proposed test in the assessment
fields.value: Proposed test with existing data: Score regenerated heads as reference-species shapes, wild-type Girardia, regeneration failure, or disorganized growth, and test whether octanol yields only the coherent classes with no intermediate shapes. A substantial fraction of failures, tumors, or intermediate outlines would refute the instructive-outcome claim.

fields.label: Evidence against
fields.value:
Absence of intermediates is an author-reported negative, without a deposited classification of every animal.

Octanol has pharmacological actions besides gap-junction block, so coherent shapes still need the hexanol and dose evidence to speak to mechanism.
